scope: Persistent state supervision, authoritative remote head and lease, raw backup and recovery, monitoring and a controlled real process interruption; no trading hypothesis
authority: Dedicated data-only Git branch in the existing repository; fetch actual latest head before I/O, ordinary fast-forward compare-and-push leases, no force-push, reject stale parent, no concurrent collection lease, no main/default-branch changes
backup: Remote Git file inventory and checkpoint, independently fetched into fresh object store; data publication stays leased until readback succeeds; restore into a new local directory. Git is admin-deletable, not WORM
daily_denominator: Per feed UTC close-exclusive in (session_start, min(day_end, asof)] only; grace windows, bootstrap, unknown and late arrivals separate; actual counts deduplicate source candle, not requests or timeframes
real_drill: Use actual public reception then SIGKILL a separate collection process, preserve partial state and UTC outage timestamps, verify process death, recover latest remotely saved valid state into new directory, re-fetch with actual current receipt; if no candle closes in the short outage, missing-bar count is zero, never fabricated
trial_status: not_started until a supervised operator explicitly activates a configured persistent host; engineering/drill minutes never count as completed seven days
level2: Requires at least real168h, all daily reports and checkpoints, backup evidence and resolved/explicit gaps. No synthetic clocks, repeated requests or projected days qualify
forbidden: paid service or new private credential provisioning
